verdict.rationale: Atlas's signup docs state that it obtains the company's tax ID (EIN) from the IRS as part of incorporation. The payments and banking docs separately reference founders acting 'before you receive your EIN', which confirms EIN delivery is a standard step of the Atlas flow. Missing for 10: detailed first-party documentation of the EIN process and timeline (especially for founders without an SSN), and independent or hands-on community corroboration of receiving the EIN through Atlas.

support.subject: As a founder, I can obtain a federal EIN for my new company through the platform

citations.quote: gets your company tax ID (EIN) from the IRS, issues founders equity, and files your 83(b) election
If eligible, apply immediately after incorporation, before you receive your EIN.
